caption: The drawing depicts a single metal bucket with two large, rounded handles attached on opposite sides near the rim. The bucket has a wide opening that tapers downwards to a narrower base. It is rendered in shades of brown and bronze, suggesting a tarnished metallic surface. The inside of the bucket is shaded darker, indicating depth, while the outer surface reflects subtle variations in color to show texture and lighting. There are three rivets visible near one handle, emphasizing the construction detail. The bucket casts a soft shadow to the right on a plain, light beige background, which is defined within a rectangular border. The artist's name, "Yolande DeLasser," appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Kettle
